mapper.sql: p.view_count, (select count(*) from post_like l where l.post_id = p.id) as like_count, (select count(*) from comment c where c.post_id = p.id and c.status = 'VISIBLE') as comment_count, (select count(*) > 0 from post_like l where l.post_id = p.id and l.ip_hash = #{ipHash}) as liked, p.pinned

p.id, p.author_id, p.happened_at, left(p.content, 140) as excerpt, p.mood, p.weather, p.visibility, u.display_name, (select m.url from post_media m where m.post_id = p.id order by m.sort_order, m.id limit 1) as cover_url, u.avatar_url as author_avatar_url,
mapper.select:
select from post p join app_user u on u.id = p.author_id
order by p.pinned desc, p.pinned_at desc,
p.happened_at asc, p.id asc
p.happened_at desc, p.id desc
limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select p.id, p.happened_at, p.location, u.display_name, (select m.url from post_media m where m.post_id = p.id order by m.sort_order, m.id limit 1) as cover_url, p.latitude, p.longitude from post p join app_user u on u.id = p.author_id where p.latitude is not null and p.longitude is not null
and p.visibility = 'PUBLIC' and p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
order by p.happened_at desc, p.id desc

select p.id, p.author_id, u.display_name, p.content, p.happened_at, p.mood, p.weather, p.location, p.visibility, p.status, p.comments_open, u.avatar_url as author_avatar_url, p.latitude, p.longitude,
from post p join app_user u on u.id = p.author_id where p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into post (author_id, content, happened_at, mood, weather, location, visibility, status, comments_open, latitude, longitude) values (#{authorId}, #{content}, #{happenedAt}, #{mood}, #{weather}, #{location}, #{visibility}, #{status}, #{commentsOpen}, #{latitude,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{longitude,jdbcType=DECIMAL})
mapper.update: update post set content = #{content}, happened_at = #{happenedAt}, mood = #{mood}, weather = #{weather}, location = #{location}, visibility = #{visibility}, status = #{status}, comments_open = #{commentsOpen}, latitude = #{latitude,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, longitude = #{longitude,jdbcType=DECIMAL} where id = #{id}
update post set view_count = view_count + 1 where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from post_like where post_id = #{postId} and ip_hash = #{ipHash}
mapper.insert: insert into post_like (post_id, ip_hash, user_id) values (#{postId}, #{ipHash}, #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.delete: delete from post_like where post_id = #{postId} and ip_hash = #{ipHash}
mapper.update: update post set pinned_at = if(pinned = 0, now(6), null), pinned = 1 - pinned where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select count(*) from post_like l join post p on p.id = l.post_id where l.user_id = #{userId}
and p.visibility = 'PUBLIC' and p.status = 'PUBLISHED'
